_readme: Curated identity facts per machine, keyed by machine number. Loaded by
app/machines/registry.py and injected into the answering model's context
as runtime data (see app/rag/machine_context.py). Keys that are not a
machine number (like this one) are ignored by the loader.
These are IDENTITY facts only - family, size, fitted configuration - the
things that let the model tell which row of a multi-machine table belongs
to this machine. Answer values (oil capacities, pressures, setpoints) do
NOT belong here: those must come from the documents, cited, every time.
The entry below is a made-up example; replace it with your own machines.

101.notes: Example entry. Free-text notes are passed to the model as written.
